# Vitruvian Beauty Advanced Repair Leave-In Conditioner and Detangler

Tired of tangles and dull, dry strands? Vitruvian Beauty Advanced Repair Treatment is a leave-in conditioner, detangler, and split-end treatment made for dry, damaged, and color-treated hair.

## Detangle Hair Without the Struggle

Spritz it onto freshly washed damp hair, or onto dry hair between washes. The detangling formula eases combing, so brushing feels smoother for adults and children alike, including those with fine or easily tangled hair.

## Nourishing Botanicals for Soft, Manageable Strands

Antioxidant-rich botanicals condition hair and help tame frizz, leaving strands soft and manageable without weighing them down. Natural bergamot, chamomile, and lavender essential oils provide a fresh, light scent.

## Gentle Formula, Clean Ingredients

This treatment is free of sulfates, parabens, phthalates, SLS, SLES, and artificial dyes or fragrances. It is cruelty-free, hypoallergenic, and made in the USA, so you can keep your routine simple and mindful.

## Refresh, Condition, and Protect Every Day

Use it as a daily refresher, a curl revitalizer, or a targeted treatment to help reduce the look of split ends. Try it risk-free with our money-back guarantee, and add Vitruvian Beauty to your hair care routine today.
